reviews.comment: 4 exams. Quizzes & group work every class. Textbook required and it couldn't explain how to pour water from a cup. 2 chp a week is the norm, sometimes 3. 90% of class is quiz, group work, and talking about them, 10% is actual lecture so you never know what to study. Exams heavy short answer. Exam review is back of chp questions

The class as a whole was fine, but Dr. Petrie takes attendance (through quizzes) at the literal beginning of class, meaning you may get a 0 for the day on attendance if you show up just 5 minutes late! The class was a 9am btw.
quiz every class but my 489 was very interesting class.

4 exams make up 70% of the final grade. Although there is no final there are over 15 different pop quizzes only 3 questions each making up another 20% of the final grade. Also, the last 10% of your final grade is based on participation which is subjective to the teacher and if she acknowledged you as participating.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's nice, but boy, is this class tough. The material is mainly conceptual, and you need to have a strong understanding of it before each exam. Multiple case studies and specific examples are tested. There is a group project at the end, and you present it to just her. She comes in loaded with questions, so be ready to defend your decisions.

Class lectures are fairly relaxed and encourage active participation, but exams are a different story. They involve mathematical applications of the theory that aren't covered in class. The professor doesn't go work any of the problems, just provides the answers. Quizzes also every day. Not worth the headache for an Econ elective.

Don't take this class, is simply not worth it. This professor basically teaches 2+2 in class, but her problem sets are entirely different from what is learned in class, which are a big percentage of your grade. Her exams are not too bad. Quizzes almost every single class.

Avoid this class. She is a nice lady, but her lectures are just simple theory that isn't difficult to understand but then the problem sets and exams are hard mathematical applications of said theory, which she does not lecture about. Quizzes every class that are only three questions, so miss one and you fail. Avoid this class.

I took her ECON 440 class and I loved it! She is a great instructor and her class really stimulated my mind. Attendance is mandatory and she does not upload lecture slides so come to class! Homework isn't too bad with a few discussion posts a week, problem sets, and a final project.
